audit.whatIsWrong: The chart hedged 'Skill' on rows the page's own prose calls decisively, and gave Shen the 2+ item row while whys[6] says a two-item stacked Nasus overwhelms you and you must not 1v1 him.
audit.why: Packet chart is Shen, Shen, Shen, Shen, Nasus, Skill, Nasus and it matches the written phases: Shen owns levels 1-5 while stacks are deniable, Fury of the Sands is Nasus's level-6 answer, and late scaling is his.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4, 5 and 6 set to the packet chart as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Spikes read correctly: Shen at 2-3 for the W+E pattern, Stand United at 6, Nasus at first item (Sheen/Trinity) and again at two items on stack count. Fury of the Sands is 120/100/80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fury of the Sands is never described. The page tells you to stack tank items without noting that his ultimate deals percent-health damage, so armour alone is the wrong answer.
audit.why: Fury of the Sands (R, 120/100/80s, 400 range) grants him health, attack range, bonus armour and MR, lowers Siphoning Strike's cooldown and burns nearby enemies by percent health. Wither (W, 700 range, 15/14/13/12/11s) is the ability that collapses your Shadow Dash angle.
audit.corrected: Level-6 rows rewritten around Fury of the Sands and its percent-health burn; Wither given its 15s rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — track every low ally. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Nasus's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy map — track every low ally. Fury of the Sands burns percent health, so do not answer it with armour.

edits.before: Nasus's Wither at max CDR plus early Trinity Force power spike means a single slowed trade punishes you hard; respect the W range and play for global R impact rather than forcing 1v1s.
edits.after: Fury of the Sands (R, 120s) hands him health, range and percent-health burn, so raw armour will not save the duel — respect Wither's 700 range and play for global R impact.

edits.before: Track Nasus's Wither: His only kite. Trade around it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Wither (15s at rank 1) is his kite. Trade on its cooldown — E-taunt into the blade, then Q.
